title: Attachment Single or 2-Way Change Solenoid Hot Short Circuit
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a hot short circuit in the attachment single or 2-way change solenoid circuit.
controller_action: • None in particular. • If the cause of the failure disappears, the machine becomes normal by itself.
machine_effect: The hydraulic circuit for attachment does not become a double-acting circuit.
related_information: Monitoring code The command (ON or OFF) from the controller to the attachment single or 2-way change solenoid can be monitored. (As long as the command from the controller is ON, the indication on the monitor is ON even if the solenoid is not energized because there is an open circuit.) (Code: 02301)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of the inspection method, see “RELA- TED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Disconnect connector V07. 3. Connect the T-adapter to the female side of connector V07. 4. Turn the starting switch to the ON position. 5. Measure the voltage. 6. Does the measurement result agree with the standard value?
